line: Ayy, say “Hello” to the bad guy
vault_lines: Ayy, say "Hello" to the bad guy
meaning:
YFN Lucci, Maine Musik, and TEC all refer to the 1983 film Scarface, particularly one scene where Tony Montana, the main character causes an outburst in a restaurant before shouting “Say goodnight to the bad guy!” on his way out.
